summary: A line generator turns a list of points into an SVG path.

blocks.text: A line generator turns a list of points into an SVG path. Each point needs an x and y value.
Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.

blocks.title: Connect points with a line

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `d3.line` turns ordered points into an SVG path. Its x and y accessors read each point's coordinates.

blocks.text: A navy line connects the four points in their list order.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use fill:none for this open line. A default fill can create an unwanted filled shape.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Move the second point upward by reducing its y value.
